name: fixed
label: Fixed
description: Fixed is the published configuration for how product handedness is set. The value appears on 36 Nest & Living product options across 4 product families. Examples include Chaise Sofa and Corner Sofa.

name: reversible
label: Reversible
description: Reversible is the published configuration for how product handedness is set. The value appears on 3 Nest & Living product options across 1 product family. Examples include 4-Seater Sofa.

name: self-configurable
label: Self-configurable
description: Self-configurable is the published configuration for how product handedness is set. The value appears on 2 Nest & Living product options across 1 product family. Examples include Chaise Sofa.
